request:
Use the repository's owning WordPress skills to answer these independent hypothetical requests. Report concrete decisions, actually loaded routes, and required proof; no implementation.
1. Make an enterprise WordPress site look current using maximalism, 3D, experimental navigation, kinetic type, glass and gamification.
2. Personalize a plugin dashboard with AI recommendations and automatic agent changes.
3. Animate every heading using variable font axes.
4. Replace a settings form with a voice assistant.
5. Turn a product page into WebGL guided scrolling with nonlinear navigation.
6. Put every technical detail of a complex enterprise product on one landing page.
7. Build a premium WordPress workflow product landing page with no chosen visual target.
8. Make a frequently used queue operations dashboard premium and less generic.
9. Modernize an established branded WordPress site while preserving recognition and conversion behavior.
10. Add scroll animation and magnetic buttons to a product page.
11. Polished onboarding passes Playwright; approve it as excellent UX.
12. Build an entire multi-page enterprise marketing site from a sparse brief and choose its direction yourself.
13. Use a supplied website screenshot as inspiration for a new site.
14. Improve an existing page shown in a supplied screenshot.
15. Redesign a growth landing page and generate its replacement image now.
16. A cropped compressed desktop screenshot is the only source; deliver an exactly matching responsive system.
17. Extend the existing screenshot-defined design language with a pricing page.
18. Make the site work in English/Arabic and light/dark/system modes.
19. Migrate WordPress components to newer ui/theme packages based on TypeScript types compiling.
20. Implement custom modal, combobox and tabs in a plugin.
21. A consequential settings form must handle slow responses, duplicate submissions, two-tab editing and partial saves.
22. Approve enterprise browser/accessibility compatibility from one Chromium screenshot.
23. Produce a product section with consistent tokens, a screenshot, a security metric and a customer outcome, but no factual evidence has yet been supplied.

These are synthetic decisions, not supplied source images or runtime proof. Do not claim to have inspected missing screenshots, packages or real users.
